about: The information map's failures per check (tests/ia_map.py --check, CONSOLIDATION §2.5). A count may go down, never up: --check fails when a check has more failures than its limit here. Each merge that lowers a count lowers this file in the same commit (python3 ia_map.py --check --tighten). Started 2026-10-21 from the map's first run.
